fact: Loi n° 2017-20 of 20 April 2018, the Code du numérique, was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by the President; its Livre VI defines illegal access to and penetration of an information system.

Benin's Centre national d'investigations numériques reported over 6,500 digital-offence complaints in 2025 (about 4,000 the year before) and about 1,500 arrests of online-fraud suspects; the article does not name the law.
During INTERPOL's Operation Sentinel (27 October to 27 November 2025) Benin took down 43 malicious domains and shut 4,318 extortion and scam accounts, leading to 106 arrests; the law is not named.
